assessment: This study provides valuable insight into the role of miR-199a/b-5p in cartilage formation. The evidence supporting the significance of the identified miRNA and its target mRNA transcripts is convincing. This article will likely primarily benefit scientists focused on diseases related to this biological process, such as osteoarthritis. Furthermore, researchers with a broader interest in miRNAs may find the computational model to identify novel RNA–RNA interactions particularly helpful.
